# FDG5037

> DO NOT provide both an indexer and methods that are semantically equivalent.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2.1 Indexed Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether an indexer and a method are semantically equivalent is a matter of meaning.

## From the book

In the following example, the indexer should be changed to a method.

```csharp
// Bad design
public class Type {
  [System.Runtime.CompilerServices.IndexerNameAttribute("Members")]
  public MemberInfo this[string memberName]{ ... }
  public MemberInfo GetMember(string memberName, Boolean ignoreCase){
... }
}
```
